Technical notes
• Only the Next.js server accesses MongoDB, through Mongoose. The FastAPI backend has no MongoDB dependency.
• The two sides share identifiers, not databases: File._id = document_id; Workspace._id = workspace_id (token
claim); Conversation.ragSessionId = session_id.
• In local and demo storage modes the backend uses FakeRedis, a library inside the backend process, for
conversation memory. A Redis server (REDIS_URL) is used only in external storage mode; the demo ran in local
mode, so no Redis server was deployed.
• Qdrant also runs embedded inside the backend process in the demo (a folder on disk).
• 12 MongoDB indexes are created and checked by the db:indexes script; uniqueness rules (duplicate PDFs,
duplicate videos, single question storage) depend on them.
EduCopilot — Multi-Modal Educational Intelligence Copilot · Accion Labs industry project (2026) · verified final integrated build, local demo configuration (not a production deployment)
